d:
The pain of judaai, felt in every frame Watch the 8K video of Judaai (Challe Vangra Judai) from the superhit Punjabi film Jatt & Juliet, starring Diljit Dosanjh and Neeru Bajwa, sung by the powerhouse Sukhwinder Singh, with music by Jatinder Shah and lyrics by Raj Kakra.
Sukhwinder Singh's soul-stirring voice captures the ache of separation in this emotional number from one of Punjabi cinema's most-loved films, now sharper than ever in 8K
